verdict.rationale: AutoGen's core interaction model is natural-language: agents are invoked with NL tasks (e.g., agent.run(task="Find information on AutoGen")) and UserProxyAgent lets users give NL feedback within multi-agent conversations. This is a first-party, well-documented pattern, though AutoGen Studio's visual/JSON interface is not purely NL and there's no independent hands-on confirmation specifically of NL-command reliability. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of NL command robustness, and clarity that all product surfaces (not just AgentChat) are NL-driven.
